MINUTES OF THE EXTRA-ORDINARY GENERAL MEETNG OF THE SHAREHOLDERS OF ZAMEEN MEDALLION (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON THE _ 
 
 The extra-ordinary general meeting (“ EOGM ”) of the shareholders of the Company was held at the registered office of the Company. Notice of the EOGM along with a copy of the proposed special resolution was circulated before the meeting as per procedure and applicable laws. 
 
 PRESENT 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Shareholder 
 Imran Ali Khan Shareholder 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan (as representative of Zameen Media ( Private ) Limited) Shareholder 
 
 CHAIRMAN 
 
 Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan took the chair with the consent of all the shareholders. 
 
 Q UORUM 
 
 Q uorum of the meeting is complete . 
 
 NOTICE 
 
 Notice convening the meeting was taken as read. 
 
 ALTERATION OF MEMORANDUM OF ASSOCIATION 
 
 It was proposed that the provisions of Clause 3(i) of the Memorandum of Association of the Company (“ Memorandum ” ) be altered to change the principal line of business of the Company. In terms of the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2017, the approval of the shareholders was sought to alter the provisions of Clause 3(i) of the Memorandum, which shall read as follows: 
 
 “ The principal line of business of the company shall be to provide IT and IT enable business process outsourcing services to various business sectors within Pakistan. Moreover, the company shall provide consultancy and other related services that are customarily provided by the business process outsourcing service providers. ” 
 
 The shareholders discussed the same and unanimously agreed to the proposed alteration of clau se 3(i) of the Memorandum of the Company , as reproduced above. 
 
 R ESOLUTIONS 
 
 Resolved unanimously , that the Company be and is hereby authorized to alter the provisions of Clause 3(i) of the Memorandum of the Company , as stated above, so as to change the principal line of business or the Company . 
 
 
 VOTE OF THANKS 
 There being no other business, the meeting was declared closed with a vote of thanks to the Chairman .
